answer.short:
Bar heights: $1,3,6,10,13,15$ at scores $8,9,10,11,12,13$ respectively.

Join the upper-right bar corners, starting at $(7.5,0)$.
answer.worked:
Use adjacent unit-width bars centred on scores $8,9,10,11,12,13$, with cumulative-frequency heights $1,3,6,10,13,15$ respectively.

The polygon joins $(7.5,0)$, $(8.5,1)$, $(9.5,3)$, $(10.5,6)$, $(11.5,10)$, $(12.5,13)$ and $(13.5,15)$.

answer.worked:
There are $15$ scores, so the median is the $8$th ordered score. The cumulative frequency is $6$ at score $10$ and $10$ at score $11$, so positions $7$–$10$ all contain $11$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median position}&=\frac{15+1}{2}\\\text{Median position}&=8\\\text{Median}&=11\end{align*}$$
